title: Retain, readmit, reduce: Expanding an ‘Early Warning System’ to prevent school dropout in Zimbabwe
why_not: The only gaps are the plan and finance of the EMIS. The text says the Early Warning System reached 545 schools in 30 districts by late March 2025 with GPE support, but does not tie it to EMIS, does not say the data are digital or who enters them, and names no plan or budget line for the ministry's system.
